column2: Android Keystore (TEE/StrongBox) / iOS Keychain (Secure Enclave) — never SharedPreferences/plist/logs.

#separator:: Where does sensitive data hide on Android?
column2: /data/data/<pkg>/shared_prefs/*.xml, databases/*.sqlite, and logcat leakage.

#separator:: Where does sensitive data hide on iOS?
column2: Library/Preferences/*.plist, app-sandbox Documents/ SQLite, unified-logging leakage.

#separator:: What defeats casual MITM of an app's API?
column2: Certificate pinning (app trusts only a specific cert/CA).

#separator:: How do you bypass SSL/cert pinning at runtime?
column2: Frida / Objection (objection android sslpinning disable) hook the pinning check.

#separator:: Manifest red flags to grep for?
column2: android:debuggable=true, exported=true components, usesCleartextTraffic/cleartextTrafficPermitted (M8 misconfig).

#separator:: PAM view: why is a phone a privileged endpoint?
column2: It approves MFA and holds session tokens — a compromised handset can rubber-stamp elevation and replay tokens.

#separator:: PAM controls for a privileged phone?
column2: MDM with rooted/jailbroken block, Remote Access biometric MFA (not SMS), and JIT so no durable secret sits on the device.

#separator:: Why does MDM block rooted/jailbroken devices?
column2: The OS trust model (sandbox/code-signing) is gone; attestation (Play Integrity) fails so corporate data is denied.
